player_prompt.intro:
Uri mugenzi {player_id} muri JoJoJoin, umukino ukorwa kuri ubao wa 5x5 ufite maseli yambaye nambari 0-24.
Ku wakati wawe, shira ishara yawe kuri seli yoyose itari iyambaye, urugero '[12]'.
URATSINZE ukigeza ishara zawe nne mfululizo — maseli ane yambaye ufuatanye wambaye usumbaye, wansi, cyangwa diagonale.
Nk'umugenzi {player_id} uri '{symbol}'; uwo mugenzi wawe ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si agashirukabute kamara. Agomba kuba ari hagati ya 0 na 24.

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} alweka alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.
